title: Record that the selected-grammar root rejects the unit tape
body:
## Summary
- The published selected-grammar root at q=3 completes only from fixture (256, 2, 0), with coefficients (0, 2) and a checker-written child body. The same check then asserts the extended root (256, 2, 1).
- Substituting unit 1 writes the root triple (256, 1, 0). The child coefficient becomes 1, and the check rejects before that body is written. No returned row is compared with the position reversal.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. This is separate from the open unit-weight machine check.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/selected-unit-root-tape-boundary/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/selected-unit-root-tape-boundary/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-unit-root-tape-boundary`
- [ ] Confirm the registered replay on the maintainer's Python 3.12 checkout
